IMPULSIVO.name: The Impulsive
IMPULSIVO.description: You spend frequently in small amounts without a clear pattern. Money goes out fast and sometimes without you noticing.
IMPULSIVO.strengths: You enjoy the present and are generous.
IMPULSIVO.risk: Small expenses add up and by the end of the month you don't know where the money went.
IMPULSIVO.tip: Try the 24-hour rule: before any non-essential purchase, wait one day.

CONSERVADOR.name: The Conservative
CONSERVADOR.description: You spend little and control your expenses well, but your income doesn't grow much either. Your money is safe but not working for you.
CONSERVADOR.strengths: You have discipline and avoid unnecessary debts.
CONSERVADOR.risk: Inflation erodes your savings if you don't invest them.
CONSERVADOR.tip: Automatically set aside 10% of each income into an investment account.

PLANIFICADOR.name: The Planner
PLANIFICADOR.description: Your income and expenses are predictable and consistent. You have real control over your finances.
PLANIFICADOR.strengths: Stability, foresight and consistent savings ability.
PLANIFICADOR.risk: You might fall into a comfort zone and miss growth opportunities.
PLANIFICADOR.tip: With your stability already achieved, explore low-risk investment funds.

VOLATIL.name: The Volatile
VOLATIL.description: You have very good months and very bad months without a clear pattern. Your cash flow is unpredictable.
VOLATIL.risk: Irregularity makes it difficult to plan medium-term goals.
VOLATIL.tip: Create a leveling fund: in good months, save an extra 20%.

ENDEUDADO.name: At Risk Zone
ENDEUDADO.description: Your expenses are exceeding or touching your income on a recurring basis. It is urgent to take action.
ENDEUDADO.strengths: Recognizing the problem is the first step.
ENDEUDADO.risk: Without adjustments, debt can escalate quickly.
ENDEUDADO.tip: List all your debts from smallest to largest and focus on eliminating the smallest first (snowball method).
